subject: Implement Agent Hub chat capture for Johnny
description:
Integrate Johnny with Agent Hub chat sessions for automatic capture.

**Project:** Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/)

**Skills:** Use `/async-python-patterns` for async patterns, `/fastapi` for integration.

**Scope:**
- Create chat capture handler
- Hook into Agent Hub chat message flow
- Capture tool uses from assistant messages
- Track session/conversation context
- Support multi-provider capture (Gemini, Claude, etc.)

**Capture Points:**
- After each assistant message with tool use
- Extract tool name, input, result
- Associate with chat session
- Track provider/model metadata

**Files:**
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/capture/chat.py (new)
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/chat/session.py (add capture hook)
- Integration with existing Agent Hub chat session management

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Chat capture handler created
- [ ] Tool uses captured from chat messages
- [ ] Session association maintained
- [ ] Provider/model tracked
- [ ] Multi-provider support verified
- [ ] Observations appear in Johnny dashboard
- [ ] `dt --check` passes
- [ ] `rebuild.sh --backend` completed (in agent-hub)

**Context Check:** If >= 60%, /compact first. If >= 75%, /commit_it then /compact.

**Completion:** Run /commit_it after verification passes.
